blocks: all unordered pairs for joint/safe_parent and all singletons for single; shuffled per sweep
restart: after a complete sweep with no improving eligible transition draw a uniform full-domain representative; continue to acceptance cutoff
polish: once per selected parent deployment/OPP tuple: rank all 27 scene OPPs by frozen proxy; propose joint proxy minima and each scene minimum with other scenes held
hard_feasibility: 500 requests; 40 ms deadline; full 10.04 s; four-node continuous thermal <=80 C; FP16
